lead_data.subject: Regarding Rafa Alejos' review & protecting Hospital Veterinario de Referencia Veterios' reputation
lead_data.body:
Hola,

I was looking through the Google profile for Hospital Veterinario de Referencia Veterios and noticed a recent 1-star review left by Rafa Alejos regarding a 4 AM emergency visit for his dog with a suspected nose foreign body (espiga).

Having worked with veterinary practices, I know how intense late-night emergency care can be. When pet owners arrive in distress at 4 AM, emotions are high, and misunderstandings about emergency fees, diagnostic protocols, or bedside manner can quickly turn into detailed, highly visible negative feedback.

Reviews like this one do more than just lower your overall star rating. Detailed 1-star reviews can directly harm your practice in two major ways:
1. Search Rankings: Google's local algorithm factors customer sentiment and review recency into Map Pack rankings. Unaddressed negative reviews can suppress your local search visibility.
2. Conversion Rate & Trust: When pet parents face an after-hours emergency, they read reviews carefully. A public dispute over fees and care can make anxious owners hesitate to bring their pets to Veterios when every minute counts.

The good news is that these situations are entirely manageable. By implementing a professional public response strategy, you can de-escalate the situation, demonstrate your medical standards to prospective clients, and turn a negative impression into a showcase of accountability. Additionally, setting up an automated review generation funnel can help consistently pull positive feedback from your many happy daily clients, effectively diluting and burying isolated 1-star reviews.

I’d love to share a few quick, practical suggestions tailored specifically for Hospital Veterinario de Referencia Veterios—no sales pitch, just actionable ideas.

Would you be open to a quick 5-minute chat this week, or should I send over a short video breakdown?

Best regards,
US agents,

lead_data.Review Text:
I visited this clinic to have three moles removed with laser treatment. I booked the appointment through the Top Doctors platform (the only way to schedule with them), where I clearly stated that the reason for the visit was the removal of warts/moles. The platform requires you to pay €110 in advance to confirm the booking.

However, the consultation was extremely brief: the dermatologist simply told me which lesions could be removed and which could not. I left exactly as I came in — without any procedure being done — but €110 out of pocket just for that “assessment.”

They then gave me a very high quote for a treatment as common as mole removal with laser. I’ve attached the quote so you can draw your own conclusions.

To be fair, they applied a small discount, which I appreciated, although they pointed out that “they don’t usually do that.” Even with the discount, the final cost was still disproportionate — €825.

If you’re a tourist or live on the island, my advice is to look for alternatives either in your place of residence or at other clinics in the south of Tenerife. Personally, I would not return to this clinic after this experience.

lead_data.Review Text:
Acudí el 14 de julio en transporte público acompañando a mi hermano, que llegó en un estado de salud muy deteriorado, con vómitos y mareos. Por su mal estado, solicitamos un volante para una ambulancia de regreso a casa. La experiencia ha sido inaceptable:

1. ​Trato denigrante e incompetencia: Al pedir el volante en el mostrador de la segunda planta del Pabellón C (servicio de Anestesia) sobre las 12:00 h, la empleada nos denegó la ayuda con una actitud borde y maleducada, excusándose textualmente en que "no sabía hacer esas cosas". No mostró la más mínima empatía ni derivó el caso a un compañero competente. Tuvimos que volver a casa en transporte público con el paciente indispuesto.

2. ​Higiene y mantenimiento deficientes: El hospital está descuidado. Los aseos estaban sucios y la desinfección es inexistente; hay decenas de dosificadores de gel hidroalcohólico por los pasillos, pero están todos vacíos.

​Me habían hablado bien del IVO, pero he comprobado que no es cierto. La calidad de un hospital se mide en sus tratamientos, pero también en el trato humano, la gestión básica y la higiene. Hoy han fallado en todo.

I showed the receptionist the ear drop I had bought from the Pharmacist and asked if the Dr is likely to prescribe something else for my daughter as she was in a lot pain and the receptionist said yes. We had to wait about 30 minutes before we were seen as there were about 4/5 people in waiting area. We were given a ticket and waited to be called, once our number was displayed we went in to the room to see the Doctor.
The Doctor wasn’t overly friendly unlike the reception staff. I showed her the drops my daughter had been taking from the chemist and the ibuprofen. She looked in her ear and said to keep using the drops I had already bought from the pharmacy. I was a little frustrated as I had asked before if my daughter would be prescribed something else and was told she would. I’m aware the receptionist aren’t medically trained but they have seen a lot of patients come and go and they were very confident something else would’ve been prescribed. Overall I felt it was a waste of €120 and time. If your child has ear ache, go on the pharmacy and buy Cetraxal Plus 3mg, Ibuprofen and apiretal (Calpol equivalent).

lead_data.Review Text:
Muy mala experiencia. Fui a la clínica hace unos meses por un problema de caída del cabello y acné persistente. En la primera consulta fueron muy amables pero en la revisión dos semanas después no se acordaban bien de mí y abrieron fichas de otros pacientes; la doctora se había comprometido a mirar unos análisis y no se había acordado; me despacharon rápidamente y sin mirarme dijeron que el acné progresaba adecuadamente. Me marché con mala imagen pero imaginé que tendrían trabajo acumulado después de la cuarentena. Hoy volví por el cabello después de unos meses como me habían indicado, remití por correo unos análisis que me mandó la doctora; cuando llegué no sabían quién era, me llamaron por un nombre incorrecto y abrieron fichas de otros pacientes. Al venir la doctora me preguntó " ¿qué te trae por aquí?", se lo recordé y no se acordaba de mí, volvió a hacerme las mismas pruebas del otro día. Le dije que ya las habíamos hecho y me remitió a su despacho; allí no había mirado los análisis que adjunté hacía unas semanas. Los miró en el momento y me recomendó un tratamiento pero no sabía dónde tenía el folleto; la secretaria y ella empezaron a abrir cajones para intentar buscarlo durante un buen rato. A continuación le pregunté en qué consistía el procedimiento y me respondió "¿cómo que en qué consiste? es un tratamiento para el pelo, se emplea a gusto del consumidor". No fue capaz de responder a la efectividad, número de sesiones... En definitiva, no había preparado en absoluto la consulta. También fui para revisar el acné y no me miró, me mandó quitarme la mascarilla y me dijo que estaba mucho mejor. Es imposible porque no se acordaba de mí y no miró las fotos de hace unos meses. Al finalizar la consulta salió del despacho a la vez que hablaba. En definitiva, nula preparación de la consulta ni atención al paciente. Me cobraron 50 euros por esta visita. No se me causó mayor perjuicio porque es una cuestión meramente estética pero considero que este trato no es de recibo; si acudo a un especialista me gustaría que supiese responder a mis preguntas, que se acuerde de mi nombre y que revise mi ficha clínica; parecía que la había tomado por sorpresa.
Mi sensación general es que la gestión de la clínica es un completo caos.

I'm extremely disappointed with the laser skin treatment service. I've been a client for 2 years, having multiple treatments, including my recent micro-needling session.

The 1st session showed great results and gave my skin a nice glow. After 6 weeks, I booked a 2nd session, but it didn't go well. My skin's become really dry, and I haven't seen any improvement.

I complained, but it led to follow-up meetings and lengthy explanations that didn't fix my skin. I'm dissatisfied and disappointed. They don't seem to acknowledge the issue.

They claim 2nd-time results never match the first, but isn't that why they recommend multiple sessions?

I've attached pics of both treatments, and it's clear the 1st session had better results. I'm not seeing any difference before and after the 2nd session 😕.

So think twice before you book for your session . Not every team member well trained .
